name: Innsbruck Airport

hours.quote: The daily operating hours of Innsbruck Airport are from 06:30 local time to 20:00 local time.

curfew.v: Closed 20:00–06:30 local. Exceptions for commercial flights: quiet props/turboprops (no louder than a Dash 8) 06:00–23:00, landings only 22:00–23:00; jets with landing noise below a Dash 8 may land 20:00–23:00. Dated extensions are listed by the airport.
curfew.quote: landings are permitted between 20:00 and 23:00 local time

customs.v: Border control during operating hours, only needed for non-Schengen flights; tell the GAC in advance if customs is needed
customs.quote: Border control: available during operating hours (only needed for non-Schengen flights)

slots.v: Slots required on Saturdays and Sundays in the winter season, and on 2 and 9 January
slots.quote: Slots: Required on day 6+7 during winter season and on 02+09 JAN only

fuel.v: Jet A-1 and Avgas via Air BP; pay by BP card, fuel release or cash only, no credit cards
fuel.quote: Payment only with BP card, fuel release or cash – no credit card!

permits.v: Crew training needed before first use of the instrument approaches below 3,000 ft weather, and for any special approach or departure procedure
permits.quote: is required before first use of the instrument approach procedures in weather conditions of less than 3000 FT
